scripts.build: npm run build -w @hall/api-contract && npm run build -w @hall/templating && npm run build -w @hall/domain && npm run build -w @hall/server && npm run build -w @hall/client && npm run build -w @hall/desktop
scripts.test:postgres: npm run build -w @hall/api-contract && npm run build -w @hall/templating && npm run build -w @hall/domain && docker compose --profile test up -d --wait postgres-test && cross-env TEST_DATABASE_URL=postgresql://hall_test:hall-test-only@127.0.0.1:54330/hall_test npm test -w @hall/server -- --run src/__tests__/postgresPersistence.test.ts
scripts.test:backend: npm run test:coverage -w @hall/server && npm run test:coverage -w @hall/domain
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @hall/api-contract && npm run build -w @hall/templating && npm run build -w @hall/domain && concurrently -k -n server,client -c blue,cyan "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.desktop:dev: npm run build -w @hall/api-contract && npm run build -w @hall/templating && npm run build -w @hall/domain && npm run build -w @hall/server && concurrently -k -n client,desktop -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @hall/client" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5174 && cross-env HALL_RENDERER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5174 npm run start -w @hall/desktop"
scripts.desktop:package: npm run build && npm run package -w @hall/desktop
scripts.desktop:make: npm run build && npm run make -w @hall/desktop
scripts.e2e:server: npm run build -w @hall/api-contract && npm run build -w @hall/templating && npm run build -w @hall/domain && npm run build -w @hall/server && npm run start -w @hall/server
scripts.lint: biome check packages/*/src packages/*/*.ts packages/desktop/scripts packages/client/e2e packages/client/scripts
scripts.lint:fix: biome check --write packages/*/src packages/*/*.ts packages/desktop/scripts packages/client/e2e packages/client/scripts
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @hall/api-contract && npm run build -w @hall/templating && npm run build -w @hall/domain && npm run typecheck -w @hall/server && npm run typecheck -w @hall/client && npm run build -w @hall/server && npm run typecheck -w @hall/desktop
scripts.quality: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test
scripts.quality:e2e: npm run quality && npm run test:e2e
